notes: The player is built for thumbs: play, skip, the scrub bar and every button on the picture are now the size Android asks for. Nothing moved — they were all too small to hit · The page behind the video is lit by the video's own colour, taken from its thumbnail · The video sits in a card, and the time on the right is how much is left rather than how long it is · Double tap the left or right of the picture to skip ten seconds, press and hold for 2×, slide up and down for brightness on the left and volume on the right · Turned sideways, the controls gather into one bar across the foot of the screen · A new rotate button beside full screen: follow the phone, hold sideways, or hold upright · Fixed: a video that was not 16:9 — an old 4:3 clip, say — was stretched to fill the frame. It keeps its own shape now · Fixed: the buttons along the top of the picture stopped responding in 0.10.10
